title: Security & Compliance review prep - 1:1 notes (Priya)
content:
Meeting objective: quick sync with Aaron before the security review meeting with finance/ops. Focus areas: SOC2 evidence gaps, ISO scope confirmation, vendor risk list + immediate remediation items.

Agenda (10-15m):
- Quick status on SOC2 evidence collection (who has docs, outstanding items)
- ISO27001: confirm scope and registrar timeline for readiness assessment
- Vendor risk: highlight 2 high-priority vendors with missing attestations
- Audit readiness checklist and who will own follow-ups
- Confirm next steps and owners for the cross-functional review meeting

Scratch notes / talking points:
- SOC2 evidence:
  - Access reviews: last completed 2025-11; need updated exec sign-off for 2026 Q1. Evidence owners: Maya (eng infra), Aaron (product infra).
  - Change management: have PR logs and deployment approvals for monthly window, but lacking centralized CM policy doc (create draft).
  - Incident response: IR playbook exists but tabletop exercise notes missing for 2025. Suggest scheduling 1 tabletop before audit kickoff.
  - Encryption at rest: KMS rotation proof is good; need key policy export for auditor. Jordan to pull policy from KMS and drop in drive.

- ISO27001:
  - Confirm scope includes hosted API and dedicated clusters, excludes some partner-managed on-prem customers. Need to finalize scope doc and get sign-off from legal.
  - Registrar availability: next assessment window proposed May 2026. Prep work: asset inventory + risk treatment plan.

- Vendor risk / third-party attestations:
  - Priority vendors missing SOC2 or ISO: XferDB (data pipeline vendor) - only has ISO self-attestation; ask for SOC2 Type II report.
  - LogStoreInc (log shipping) - no recent attestations; consider temporary mitigation: restrict PII and enable encryption + split logs by customer.
  - Action: compile vendor matrix with current attestation and expiry dates. Aaron to lead; target deliverable: vendor-matrix v0 by 2026-03-11.

- Audit readiness checklist (high level):
  - Evidence inventory: who/where (drive links) - owners assigned.
  - Policies: finalize CM policy, data retention, vendor management policy (drafts exist but need consolidation).
  - Process owners: assign for access reviews, onboarding/offboarding, incidents - map names to controls.
  - Technical proof: config exports (KMS, IAM roles, networking), backup jobs, retention windows.
  - Training artifacts: security awareness completion report (HR) - request updated export.

Open questions to raise with Aaron:
- Do we plan to scope Dedicated clusters differently for ISO vs SOC2? (possible narrower ISO scope to speed registrar approvals)
- Risk appetite change from execs? (if lower appetite, we may need faster remediation timelines)
- Any large contracts with new vendors in last 6 months that we haven't onboarded into vendor risk process?

Immediate action items (post 1:1):
- Aaron: assemble vendor matrix draft (columns: vendor, service, attestation type, expiry, owner, risk note) - due 2026-03-11.
- Maya: export KMS key policy and drop into evidence folder + add path in vendor matrix - due 2026-03-06.
- Jordan: pull IR tabletop notes and recent incident post-mortems into drive - due 2026-03-08.
- Priya (me): draft change management policy skeleton and link to CM evidence; schedule tabletop exercise invite for Apr 2026 - due 2026-03-10.
- Schedule cross-functional review (security + legal + ops + product) week of 2026-03-15. Coordinate with legal for ISO scope sign-off.

Notes to self (scratchpad):
- Keep evidence folder structure simple: /audit-evidence/2026/{SOC2,ISO,vendor-adt,policies,tech-exports}. Add README with owners and file expectations.
- Possible quick wins to reduce vendor risk: require TLS + encryption at rest + contract clause for SOC2 or annual self-attestation.
- Look up previous audit findings (2024) to ensure we closed action items - search Confluence for "audit findings 2024".

Potential blockers:
- Legal bandwidth for contract clauses and vendor follow-up. Plan: escalate to GC if vendor resp is slow.
- Missing owners for a couple of controls (e.g., data classification). Need product input.

Follow-up items to add to calendar after 1:1:
- Draft vendor matrix review slot (30m) with Aaron & Maya - target 2026-03-12.
- Evidence folder walkthrough (15-20m) with audit ops - target 2026-03-16.
- All-hands prep for security audit kickoff (prep deck) - assign presenter(s) and slides.

Random notes / phrases to include in prep deck:
- "Audit posture: improving, targeted remediation underway"
- "Top 3 risks: vendor attestations, CM policy gaps, IR tabletop cadence"
- "Immediate mitigations: restricted vendor access, updated key policies, scheduled tabletop"

End of notes. Will tidy before sending as agenda for cross-functional meeting.
